Why work here

Four things you would feel in your first month.

  • 01No account-manager layer.

    The person doing the work talks to the client. Strategists own the relationship.

  • 02Own verticals, not tasks.

    We do not hand out projects, we hand out P&Ls. You carry the outcome, not just the task list.

  • 03Write your own brief.

    Every senior here is expected to ship a brief unprompted in their first 90 days.

  • 04Early enough to shape it.

    The person who joins next helps decide how this place works, not just what it ships.

How hiring works

Four steps. No portal.

You meet the people you would work with before anyone makes a decision.

  1. Step 1. One page

    What you would own, what you would change in ninety days, and what you need from us. No resume, no portal.

  2. Step 2. A conversation

    A call with whoever runs the discipline. Mostly you asking us things.

  3. Step 3. A real problem

    One paid piece of actual work from a live account, scoped to a day. We pay for it either way.

  4. Step 4. The rest of the team

    You meet everyone before anyone decides.

Before you apply

Small is the job, not a phase.

Will frustrate you
  • You want a defined laneThe lane changes. Some weeks you will do work that is not yours.
  • You need a manager to unblock youThere is no manager layer. You decide, ship, and tell us afterwards.
  • You want a big-company benefits sheetWe do not have one, and we would rather say so than list things we cannot back.
  • You are waiting for process to arriveYou would be the person writing it. That is the job, not a phase before the job.
You would do well
  • You have done the work yourselfNot managed someone doing it. The person with the plan also builds it.
  • You want the client in the roomYou will be on the call, owning the number, without anyone translating for you.
  • You would rather own an outcome than a taskWe hand out P&Ls. You will carry several, and all of the result.
  • You want a say in what this becomesThe shape of the company is still an open question.
Common questions

Questions before you apply.

Do I need a resume?

No. Apply with a single page: what you would own, what you would change in the first ninety days, and what you need from us. If you have a CV, you can add a link.

What is the hiring process?

Four steps: one page, a conversation with whoever runs the discipline, one paid piece of real work scoped to a day, and a meeting with the rest of the team before anyone decides.

Is the work test paid?

Yes. We pay for the piece of work either way.

Where will I work?

MMC is based in Thane, Maharashtra. Each role page states its location and whether it is onsite, hybrid or remote.

What if my role is not listed?

Write the role yourself. Send one page saying what you would own and what you would change in ninety days, using the button on this page.

Which kinds of brands would I work on?

D2C brands, B2B companies and educational institutes. D2C is where we go deepest. See a few of the brands we work with.

How to apply

One page. That is the application.

Pick a role above and use its form, or write your own: what you would own, change in ninety days, and need from us.
